title: Adam Back: Pension Funds Are Bitcoin’s “Third Wave” of Adoption
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Adam Back: Pension Funds Are Bitcoin’s “Third Wave” of Adoption Adam Back explains why Bitcoin’s third wave—pensions, managed funds, and model portfolios—is still to come, and how Swiss banks are already preparing. This post Adam Back: Pension Funds Are Bitcoin’s “Third Wave” of Adoption first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mark Mason .
